server.name: kicad-mcp-server
server.description: MCP server for KiCAD PCB design operations

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search all available KiCAD tools by keyword. Returns matching tool names and their categories.

tools.name: list_toolboxes
tools.description: List the toolboxes: groups of related KiCad tools, each with a description, its tools, and whether it is open. Your tool list holds the core tools plus the tools of open toolboxes; open a toolbox with

tools.name: open_toolbox
tools.description: Open one or more toolboxes (see list_toolboxes) to add their tools to your tool list. In most clients the new tools can be called from the user's next message, not in the current turn, so open what a

tools.name: close_toolbox
tools.description: Close one or more toolboxes to remove their tools from your tool list and free context. The core tools stay.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new KiCAD project

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open an existing KiCAD project

tools.name: open_board
tools.description: Open a specific .kicad_pcb board file and refresh the MCP in-memory board state.

tools.name: reload_board
tools.description: Reload the current or specified .kicad_pcb from disk, discarding stale in-memory board state.

tools.name: close_project
tools.description: Close the currently loaded KiCAD project: optionally save, then drop the in-memory board and clear session state. Use this to hand control back so the user (or the agent) can edit project files direct

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the current KiCAD project. Refuses to overwrite the board file if its contents changed on disk since load (external edit) unless force is true.

tools.name: save_board
tools.description: Save the current PCB board. Refuses to overwrite external disk edits unless force=true.

tools.name: save_as
tools.description: Save the current PCB board to a new .kicad_pcb path.

tools.name: is_dirty
tools.description: Return whether the MCP knows the loaded board has unsaved memory changes or external disk changes.

tools.name: discard_or_reload
tools.description: Discard the current in-memory PCB state and reload the board from disk.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Get information about the current KiCAD project

tools.name: snapshot_project
tools.description: Save a named checkpoint snapshot of the current project state (renders board to PDF and records step label). Call after completing each major step — e.g. after Step 1 (schematic_ok) and Step 2 (layout

tools.name: set_board_size
tools.description: Set the PCB board dimensions (width and height) in the specified unit.

tools.name: get_board_info
tools.description: Retrieve general information about the current PCB board (dimensions, layer count, DRC status).

tools.name: add_board_outline
tools.description: Draw the PCB board outline (Edge.Cuts layer) as a rectangle, rounded rectangle, circle or polygon.

tools.name: clear_board_outline
tools.description: Delete all Edge.Cuts graphics from the current PCB board.

tools.name: replace_board_outline
tools.description: Replace the current Edge.Cuts board outline with a rectangle, rounded rectangle, circle or polygon.

tools.name: place_component
tools.description: Place a footprint component onto the PCB at the specified position. Optionally set reference, value, footprint, rotation and layer.

tools.name: move_component
tools.description: Move a PCB component to a new position. Optionally update rotation or flip to a different copper layer.

tools.name: batch_move_components
tools.description: Move multiple PCB components transactionally. If one reference/spec is invalid, no components are moved. Saves by default unless save=false.

tools.name: get_component_geometry
tools.description: Return separated footprint geometry bboxes: body, pads, courtyard, keepout, fab, silk and text.

tools.name: add_net
tools.description: Create a new net on the PCB

tools.name: route_trace
tools.description: Route a trace segment between two XY points on a fixed layer. WARNING: Does NOT handle layer changes — if start and end are on different copper layers, use route_pad_to_pad instead, which automaticall

tools.name: add_schematic_component
tools.description: Add a component to the schematic. Symbol format is 'Library:SymbolName' (e.g., 'Device:R', 'EDA-MCP:ESP32-C3')

tools.name: add_schematic_net_label
tools.description: Add a net label to the schematic. PREFERRED: supply componentRef + pinNumber to snap the label to the exact pin endpoint — this guarantees an electrical connection. Alternatively supply position [x, y

tools.name: connect_to_net
tools.description: Connect a component pin to a named net by adding a wire stub and net label at the exact pin endpoint. The response includes pin_location (exact pin coords), label_location (where the label was placed)

tools.name: connect_passthrough
tools.description: Connects all pins of a source connector (e.g. J1) to matching pins of a target connector (e.g. J2) via shared net labels — pin N gets net '{netPrefix}_{N}'. Use this for FFC/ribbon cable passthrough a

tools.name: list_schematic_components
tools.description: List all components in a schematic with their references, values, positions, and pins. Essential for inspecting what's on the schematic before making edits.

tools.name: annotate_schematic
tools.description: Assign reference designators to unannotated components (R? → R1, R2, ...). Must be called before tools that require known references. Numbers are unique across the whole project, each use of a sheet t

tools.name: sync_schematic_to_board
tools.description: Import the schematic netlist into the PCB board — equivalent to pressing F8 in KiCAD (Tools → Update PCB from Schematic). MUST be called after the schematic is complete and before placing or routing c

tools.name: create_board_from_schematic
tools.description: Create a new .kicad_pcb file from a schematic, then update the PCB from that schematic so footprints and nets are present.

tools.name: get_backend_state
tools.description: Return the active backend, realtime status, loaded project/board paths, and dirty state.

tools.name: check_kicad_ui
tools.description: Check if KiCAD UI is currently running
